basic_info.description: Residence 503 at ever-fabulous The Pacific offers an entry into an ease of lifestyle treasured today more than ever. Experience a full-service, luxury building just a block from Fillmore St, the finest neighborhood nexus in SF. Positioned mid-span on the sunny south side, the great room's view transports one across the City to the distant hills. The open plan encompasses living, dining & European kitchen with statuario marble island for counter seating. Ceilings are approximately 11'; when enjoyed in concert with floor-to-ceiling windows & tall bookcases the volume is impressive. Soothing primary suite enjoys southern views with nearby synagogue's dome. Includes generous dressing rm & stone bath with dual sinks, shower. Handsomely finished second bedroom & hall full bath complete the residence. Curated light fixtures, wide plank pale European oak floors, automated solar shades, bedroom drapes, in-home laundry & one independent parking space with EV charger included. Five-star amenities include the Grand Lobby staffed 24/7, concierge, optional valet parking, Fitness Studio, Observatory Lounge with view terrace, and The Fillmore Suite for guests. Air-conditioning, elevators. A+ location between Alta Plaza Park & Lafayette Park, this is San Francisco north side living at its best!
